reason: Two records that must not be left implicit: the provenance of the stage-1 budget freeze (amendment 04), and the evidential positioning of Llama's degenerate tails against this repo's own GSM8K precedent.

provenance_of_amendment_04.what_happened: docs/p4_amendment_04.json was produced by an EARLIER build of decide_p4_budget.py in which a format violation printed a warning and then wrote the amendment anyway. llama alpha=-6 reads 19/20, so that build emitted the warning AND left the artifact on disk. The warning-then-write behaviour was subsequently replaced (commit 407e6ab) by a hard stop before any write, and the gate itself was then relaxed by p4-amend-05.
provenance_of_amendment_04.why_it_was_kept_rather_than_regenerated: Re-running the CURRENT code against the same two preflight files produces a byte-equivalent object: a key-by-key comparison of the as-found artifact against a fresh recomputation reported NO differing keys. So amendment 04 is exactly what the current, gate-corrected code writes. Archiving it under a new number would leave the 04 slot permanently empty while p4-amend-02 and p4-amend-05 both already name amendment 04 as the stage-1 freeze -- creating more inconsistency than it removes.
provenance_of_amendment_04.what_is_NOT_claimed: This does not retroactively bless the warning-then-write build. That was a real defect and is fixed. The artifact survives because its CONTENT was independently reproduced under the corrected code, not because the build that first wrote it is now considered acceptable.

degenerate_tails_are_a_known_repo_phenom.correction: The preflight outcome record presented Llama's degenerate tails as a newly surfaced problem that put readability in question. That framing OVERSTATED it. This repo's principal GSM8K result set was produced under a strictly more extreme version of the same phenomenon.

gsm8k_precedent.cap_hit: 97% of trajectories hit the 767 max_new_tokens cap
gsm8k_precedent.loop_baseline: raw loop rate 74-88% across alpha, with no clean alpha trend
gsm8k_precedent.tail_form: the text after the 2nd '####' is a degenerate '#### N ...' loop, NOT reasoning
gsm8k_precedent.consequence: GSM8K remains one of this project's main result sources. Cap-hit and looping did not make it unreadable.

degenerate_tails_are_a_known_repo_phenom.why_accuracy_stays_readable: The answer is fully produced BEFORE the degeneration. GSM8K takes the FIRST '####', so the repeated tail is post-submission. In the LogiQA preflight the parallel evidence is that FIRST and LAST agree in 39 of 40 scorable outputs -- the repetition repeats the SAME letter.
degenerate_tails_are_a_known_repo_phenom.a_real_difference_that_does_not_change_t: The two degeneration morphologies are NOT identical and must not be described as one phenomenon. GSM8K's '####' is terminal by construction, so its loop is always post-submission. LogiQA's Llama alpha=0 shows 13/20 answer_first, i.e. the marker precedes any derivation -- a different shape. Both nonetheless leave a complete submitted answer before the degeneration, which is what accuracy readability requires.
degenerate_tails_are_a_known_repo_phenom.adopted_reading_convention: Follow the GSM8K convention: the degeneration rate is a DESCRIPTIVE readout and MUST NOT be read as perseveration unless it shows a clean alpha trend. The GSM8K precedent for this is explicit -- a 74-88% baseline with no alpha trend is exactly why the raw loop rate is barred from a perseveration reading there.
degenerate_tails_are_a_known_repo_phenom.detector_is_shared_deliberately: degenerate_rate uses the repo's is_loop convention (final 40-character block recurring >=4x), the same strict definition GSM8K uses, so the two tasks stay comparable. A permissive n-gram proxy is explicitly rejected: on GSM8K it read 80-86% and every flagged case was a false positive.
degenerate_tails_are_a_known_repo_phenom.not_an_exemption: Citing the precedent does not waive quantification. The rates are measured, reported per cell, and carried into the formal run as frozen descriptive fields (p4-amend-05).

unchanged_by_this_amendment: the prompt, anchor, parser and MAIN/sensitivity convention
the four cells and their alpha
the primary metric, exact McNemar, bootstrap CI and the m=2 Holm family
